topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I was just browsing, killing some time before my next appointment, when I spotted it. The ring, with its distinctive emerald cut diamond and delicate etchings, was unmistakable. I remember the way Grandma used to polished it, her hands gentle as she spoke of Grandpa. The pawn shop was dim, the lights giving everything a soft glow, but the ring caught my eye like a beacon. The shopkeeper told me it had been there for months, forgotten until today. I traced the band with my finger, the cool metal sending a shiver up my spine. There were so many questions, but for a moment, all I could do was stare, the room around me fading into the background.
